notes:
- Fixed: the slider position carried over when you opened another game, making it look as though Tempo had already changed that game too
- Each game now keeps its own slider position, and a game you have not touched always opens at Balanced
- To be clear: your games were never affected by each other - each one only ever writes to its own settings file
- The Driver section now names the graphics profile it edits and how many of that game's programs it covers
